data.data:
Endministrator, you have a pending Blueprint Assistance notification: Round 2 of the [AIC Factory Blueprint Showcase] is now live!

Join the in-game event [AIC Support: Palm-Top Savior] by submitting Xiranite Gourds to earn Wuling Stock Bills and Fruits of Altruism Certs, which can be exchanged for supplies.

Share your blueprint design approach outside the game to exchange ideas with fellow players and get a chance to win Amazon Gift Cards!

Small as the gourd may be, it holds a whole universe within. And for that universe to be revealed to the world ... we need you, Endministrator, to showcase your creativity and share your blueprints!

Head over to the official Discord community to share your blueprint design approach! Exchange ideas with fellow players and get a chance to win Amazon Gift Cards or a one-month Discord Nitro subscription! 🎁


▼ Event Time: Apr. 29, 2026 at 17:00 – May 31, 2026 at 23:59 (UTC+8)

Asia Server Time Zone: UTC+8

Americas / Europe Server Time Zone: UTC-5


Join Now >>https://discord.gg/qjmfxZDEXN

Please visit our official Discord for more participation details and event rules.
